items.title: UK P&I Club sets 4.5% general increase for 2027 policy year
items.summary: The marine mutual has announced a 4.5% general increase alongside a target rise in smaller deductibles, down from last year's 7.5% adjustment.

items.title: Chesnara agrees to acquire MetLife UK closed book in fourth deal in two years
items.summary: Chesnara has agreed to purchase MetLife UK Limited, adding £1.7 billion of assets under administration in its fourth acquisition in two years.

items.title: Marsh appoints Marcus Baker to marine chairman role as Michael Walls steps up
items.summary: Marsh has named Marcus Baker as chairman of marine, cargo and logistics at Marsh Risk, with Michael Walls taking over as global head.

items.title: Hastings Direct plans to hire 500 staff over next year as rival Admiral cuts jobs
items.summary: Digital insurer Hastings Direct is recruiting more than 500 people across multiple disciplines as it approaches 5 million customers, moving in the opposite direction to rival Admiral.
